description:
Advances: specled.package, specled.triangulation

Go-live gate ticket (2026-07-25): the shipped .spec/ corpus is the adoption-facing proof of the spec-code-test integrity pitch and must contain no provably false statements at launch. Split out of specled_-vk0, which keeps only the deferred hardening work (lookbehind bounds, severity-corpus asymmetry, digit codes, stale-marker sweep, two-way mirror).

Two live inaccuracies, both verified against code during the 2026-07-24 triage (see specled_-vk0 description + last comment for full evidence):

1. package.spec.md doc_identifier_integrity must OVERCLAIMS: the lint guards 3 of at least 5 emitted finding-code namespaces — evidence/* (emitted at lib/specled_ex/evidence/store.ex:46, evidence/sync.ex:266,431,455, mix/tasks/spec.prune.ex:47-60, spec.sync.ex:41), detector_unavailable (lib/specled_ex/review.ex:537), and spec_requirement_too_short are unguarded; the corpus merely happens to be clean today. Fix: widen @token_patterns to cover the unguarded namespaces OR narrow the must to claim only what is guarded. Maintainer call on widen-vs-narrow, then mechanical.

2. triangulation.spec.md scenario asserts a given/when the implementation and tests do not perform (fabricated scenario text found in the specled_-6fn ship-it critical review, restated in the specled_-vk0 comment). Fix: rewrite the scenario to describe actual behavior, through append-only ceremony.

NOT in scope here (already covered by specled_-dn4.8, which is being finished as part of the P1 dn4 epic): F37 boundary_row_preferred_on_flush contradicting a must in the same file, and F39 coverage qualifier ids asserting the opposite of their names. Do not double-fix.

Verification: mix spec.check green + the corpus-scoped doc-identifier lint; per-claim code citations above make each fix mechanically checkable.

Flagging pre-commit precisely because a wrong count in an ADR about identifier honesty is the defect class this ticket exists to remove.

Pre-existing, not introduced by either commit, and 242642a made the situation strictly more honest by removing the overclaiming test name. Worth a hardening ticket if that clause needs to be load-bearing.
- The evidence/* false-positive vector the new comment documents (a bare relative path like "see evidence/sync.ex" would be flagged) is real and correctly scoped to specled_-vk0. I confirmed no such reference exists today.
- 242642a self-reports an untested gap honestly in its own commit message: the family test exercises one code per family, so omitting a single code from an allowlist is caught by nothing. I confirmed that is accurate, and that the direction is benign (an omission makes the lint stricter and fails loudly on the next real reference).
- agent-session lines returns the same session id the implementer reported, because it resolves the harness session rather than the subagent. Verification was performed cold: ticket, specs, ADR, and both commit diffs read fresh, every claim re-derived from lib/ and the corpus by execution rather than taken from the implementer or the orchestrator.

title: Spec-honesty slice: fix the two provably false statements in the shipped .spec/ corpus
